llm_summary: Summary: The overall sentiment regarding the CeraVe Oil Control Moisturizing Gel-Cream is mixed, as users are initially drawn to its well-regarded formulation of ceramides, niacinamide, and hyaluronic acid. While many appreciate its lightweight, ingredient-conscious profile for oily and acne-prone skin, several users report significant irritation and a burning sensation upon application. These negative reactions often occur when the product is used on compromised skin barriers or in climates where the user's skin is unexpectedly dry.
